ProxyIdentity.name: X-Forwarded-User
ProxyIdentity.description: Trusted reverse proxy identity in header mode. The header name can be configured with DEBBUILDER_AUTH_HEADER. Never expose this header directly to untrusted clients.

OidcSession.name: debbuilder_session
OidcSession.description: Interactive OIDC session cookie established by the separate browser login flow.

details.description: Only allowlisted, bounded diagnostic fields are exposed.

Recipe.description: Authored Recipe v5. The complete nested business rules are enforced by recipe_schema.py; this schema documents stable public fields without claiming to replace that validator.

RecipeInput.description: Recipe directly or wrapped in a recipe property.

EmptyRequest.description: An omitted JSON body is also accepted and treated as {}.

IgnoredRequest.description: The handler currently ignores request fields; use {}.

SettingsInput.description: Partial settings update; secret replacements are write-only and never returned.

PackageInput.description: Package override fields are normalized by package_service.py.

Package.description: Projection of Recipe, Run and APT repository state.

Execution.description: Public Build Run lifecycle projection; some fields depend on available evidence.

Publication.description: Public publication attempt projection on successful HTTP responses.

Automation.description: Current Recipe automation status and scheduler evidence.

AutomationAction.description: Scheduler acceptance plus the updated Recipe automation status.

Settings.description: Redacted operator settings view; secret values are omitted.

Storage.description: Cached storage inventory; GET does not collect or mutate it.

ArchiveInspection.description: Selected archive inventory and payload summary.

SystemDiagnosticDetails.description: Allowlisted scalar fields only. Fields vary by check; no paths, commands, exception text, or secrets.

SystemDiagnosticsResponse.description: Global failed if any check failed, otherwise warning if any warning/unknown, otherwise ok. Individual probe failures return unknown and HTTP 200.

x-debbuilder-auth-modes.none: Configured local mode requires no credential.
x-debbuilder-auth-modes.header: Configured trusted proxy identity header is required.
x-debbuilder-auth-modes.oidc: Configured OIDC browser session cookie is required; API failures are JSON rather than redirects.
